purpose: Same-machine synthetic measurements and bounded native verification; no production or phone data.
limitations: No physical phone, real WAN, cloud cold-start or database auto-suspend measurement.
Page timing uses actual VM setData completion callbacks, not native frame presentation.
100 pairs use 3 samples per implementation; 1000 pairs use 1 sample. No P95 inference.
Timing begins after initial workbench summary/list. Optional pagination and user thinking time are excluded.
Request and SQL durations can overlap; do not sum them with client wall time.

environment.timing: local handler/real Page VM setData callback proxy; excludes phone rendering, cloud cold-start and network
local real Page/service/handler; setData callback VM proxy, excludes native rendering, real network and cloud cold-start
environment.sql: database round trips including transaction controls; overlapping SQL ms must not be added to client wall time
environment.sourceHashScope: Git-listed JS/JSON/WXML/WXSS under cloudfunctions, shared and miniprogram, plus test/helpers/read-runtime.js; includes untracked, non-ignored source files

metricDefinitions.requestBoundary: real Page cloud-call adapter entering the real local import service through its promise settlement; initial workbench summary/list and closing are excluded
metricDefinitions.observedSerialRequestRounds: longest chain of non-overlapping real requests by exact start/settlement event order: start round = 1 + maximum round already settled; zero requests gives zero rounds. This measures temporal serialization, not a proven await/causal dependency graph; concurrency limits and independent scheduling can also increase it
metricDefinitions.maxConcurrentRequests: maximum requests entered but not yet settled at the same real-service boundary; not SQL connection concurrency
metricDefinitions.duplicateRequests: within one sample, sum(count - 1) for repeated action plus canonical JSON data; object key order and omitted undefined do not change identity, array order does; first requests are excluded
metricDefinitions.duplicateRequestGroups: number of action-plus-data identities requested more than once; duplicateActions groups only excess requests by action; no arguments or identity keys are emitted
metricDefinitions.viewSessionCache: existing import-view-session cache events captured before observer retention filtering. hits includes retained responses and pending-request coalescing; these cannot be separated by the existing event. Baseline without this emitter reports available:false and null counts, not inferred zero hits
metricDefinitions.requestTimeline: actual start/settlement elapsed ms plus unrounded event order and observed round; actions only, no request arguments
metricDefinitions.failedRequests: real service rejection, synchronous throw, or response without ok:true

environment.isolation: fresh synthetic user and newly migrated loopback schema per sample, API/import minimum-grant roles
environment.timing: instrumented local handler and real Page VM setData callback proxy; excludes user thinking, phone rendering, network and cloud cold-start
environment.boundary: starts after initial workbench summary/list; counts all actual page requests through final saved summary; optional preview pagination is not simulated

metricDefinitions.firstFeedbackMs: first sheet setData callback after opening
metricDefinitions.serverMs: sum of real local handler invocation-to-response durations; parallel reads overlap, so not additive to Page wall time
metricDefinitions.mutationServerMs: sum of real resolve handler durations; excludes page reads and UI callbacks
metricDefinitions.maxMutationServerMs: slowest bounded resolve request; includes connection acquisition and database work, excludes cloud/network
metricDefinitions.allSavedMs: first explicit confirmation through last successful command receipt
metricDefinitions.fullProjectionRefreshes: actual reconciliation.refreshProjectedEvents calls without a bounded event scope
metricDefinitions.bytes: UTF-8 JSON bytes; actual setData bridge patches after chunking

native.layout: Final three templates recompiled and screenshot inspected using captured synthetic Page data after DB bridge shutdown; no additional write.
native.sourceContext: Native interaction ran on the uncommitted implementation identified by sourceHash. Later changes restored the non-mixed-source historical check and updated the security dependency; final layout was recompiled from the final templates. This is separate from final-commit VM/MySQL timing.

homeStateCheck.authorization: user explicitly authorized completing the remaining read-only check

cloudDeploymentVerification.boundary: Deployment checks are separate from the local synthetic performance measurements above; no real ledger experiment or production performance result is claimed.
